question: A bakery bakes 80 loaves of bread every day. they have an order for 2400 loaves. if they bake for 8 hours each day and produce at a constant rate, how many days will it take to complete the order?

A farmer has a chicken coop that holds 3 dozen chickens. each chicken lays 5 eggs per week, but some eggs are lost because of a fox that steals 2 eggs every day. how many eggs does the farmer collect weekly?
Michael wants to buy a laptop that costs $1200 and a printer that costs $300. he has saved $1000 but needs to borrow the rest from his friend. how much money does michael need to borrow?

A school surveyed 500 students about their favorite sports - basketball, soccer, tennis, or swimming. 90 students chose basketball, 130 chose tennis, and 160 chose soccer. how many students preferred swimming?

A gardener has 8 flower beds, each containing 15 rose plants. he plans to plant 5 more rose plants in each bed but realizes he only has enough roses to add new plants to 6 of the beds. how many rose plants does the gardener have in total after planting?

Liam wants to buy a bicycle priced at $600. he plans to pay in monthly installments of $50 for 12 months. his uncle agrees to lend him the full amount plus a one-time 8% interest fee on the total loan. including interest, how much money will liam owe his uncle?

Samantha wants to buy a new laptop that costs $800. she has saved $200 so far and plans to save $50 every week from her part-time job. if she also receives a one-time gift of $100 from her aunt, how many weeks will it take samantha to have enough money to buy the laptop?
A bookstore sells novels for $15 each and magazines for $5 each. if a customer buys 4 novels and some magazines, spending a total of $80, how many magazines did the customer buy?

A gardener planted 4 rows of tomato plants with 12 plants in each row. each plant produces 8 tomatoes per week, but some are lost due to pests that eat 3 tomatoes daily. how many tomatoes does the gardener harvest weekly?

Mark has 10 notebooks that weigh 3/4 of a pound each, and his backpack weighs 5 pounds. he needs one sticker for every 2 pounds to label the weight. how many stickers does mark need to label his backpack?

A bakery makes 50 chocolate cakes, 40 vanilla cakes, and 30 strawberry cakes for a party. if they want to pack the cakes equally into boxes without cutting any cake, what is the greatest number of cakes that can be packed in each box?

A rabbit eats 15 pounds of food per day, which is 5 times more than a squirrel eats per day. a chipmunk eats 1/50 as much as the squirrel does per day, but a bear eats 3000 times more than the chipmunk does per day. how much more, in pounds, does the bear eat per day than the rabbit?

Maria is selling handmade candles at a craft fair. she earns $15 commission for each candle sold. the fair has three sections with 10, 12, and 8 booths respectively. the first section sold twice as many candles as the second section, while the third section sold half the number of candles as the first section. if maria earned a total commission of $1,350, how many candles did she sell in the second section?
A teacher has 5 boxes of pencils, each containing 20 pencils. she gives 3 pencils to each student in her class. if there are 25 students, how many pencils does the teacher have left?
A gardener plants 5 rows of tomato plants, with 12 plants in each row. after a week, he plants 3 more rows with the same number of plants per row. how many tomato plants does he have now?
A baker bakes 8 trays of cookies, with 15 cookies on each tray. after an hour, she bakes 5 more trays with the same number of cookies per tray. how many cookies does she have now?

Liam's blog receives 150 visitors each day for the first 5 days of the week. on the sixth day, he gets three times as many visitors as on a regular day, and on the seventh day, he gets twice as many visitors as on the sixth day. if liam earns $0.02 per visitor, how much money does he make that week?
A farmer has 12 apple trees, each producing 30 apples. he decides to plant 3 more trees, each producing 25 apples. how many apples will the farmer have in total when all the trees bear fruit?
A beekeeper starts with 15,000 bees in the hive. every day, 2,500 new bees hatch from the queen's eggs, but 1,200 bees leave the hive daily. how many bees are there in total after 10 days?

A factory produces toy cars. when the machine is cold, it takes 8 minutes to produce each car. once warmed up, it only takes 6 minutes per car. how many more cars are produced in the last hour compared to the first hour of operation?
Lily bakes cookies for a fundraiser. she bakes 30 cookies every hour and sells them in packs of 6. if she works for 4 hours, how many packs of cookies does she sell?

Liam plans to spend 1/4 of a day studying. he studies math, science, and history. he studies 15 pages an hour for math, 25 pages an hour for science, and 35 pages an hour for history. if he spends equal time on each subject, how many pages does he study in total?

A gardener wants to plant 1200 flowers in his garden. he can buy half of the flowers at a 40% discount on the regular price of $1.00 each. for the other half, he must pay full price. how much money will the gardener spend in total?

Emma is organizing a charity event and has 150 invitations to send out. on monday, she sends out 40% of the invitations. on tuesday, she sends out 50% of the remaining invitations. how many invitations does she still need to send on wednesday?
A zoo has 15 elephants and each elephant eats 250 pounds of food daily. if the zoo wants to stock enough food for a week, how many pounds of food should they prepare?

A library has 120 books divided into four genres: fiction, non-fiction, mystery, and science. there are 15 fiction books and twice as many non-fiction books as fiction. mystery books make up 25% of the total number of books. how many science books are there?
A bakery bakes 5 batches of cookies every morning and 7 batches every evening. each batch contains 24 cookies. if the bakery sells all the cookies in a day, how many cookies do they sell in total?

A gardener plants rose bushes and tulip bulbs in her garden. each rose bush requires 3 hours of care per week, and each tulip bulb requires 1 hour of care per week. she has planted twice as many tulip bulbs as rose bushes and spends a total of 36 hours caring for them weekly. how many hours does she spend caring for all the plants?

Mrs. tan collects eggs from her hens twice a day. yesterday morning, she collected 72 eggs and in the evening, she collected 88 eggs. this morning, she collected 15 eggs fewer than yesterday morning. after selling some eggs in the afternoon, mrs. tan has only 30 eggs left. if each egg sells for $0.25, what was her total revenue?

Samantha buys notebooks and pens for school. she buys three packs of notebooks, each containing 12 notebooks, and five packs of pens, each containing 8 pens. if she uses 2 notebooks and 3 pens every week, how many weeks will her supplies last?

A bakery made 120 cupcakes in the morning and 150 cupcakes in the afternoon. the next morning, they baked 20 fewer cupcakes than the previous morning. after selling some cupcakes during the day, only 40 cupcakes remained. if each cupcake sells for $1.50, what was the total revenue from the sales?

Emma earns $12 an hour tutoring science. in the first month, she earned $240; in the second month, she earned $180 more than the first month. how many hours did emma spend tutoring over the two months?

Emily buys a laptop for $1200. she also purchases a software package costing $250 and a warranty plan for $150. additionally, she spends $0.10 per mile on transportation to pick up the laptop from the store, driving 60 miles round trip. what is emily's total expense?

A music store has 150 instruments divided into four categories: guitars, pianos, drums, and violins. there are 20 guitars and three times as many pianos as guitars. drums make up 20% of the total number of instruments. how many violins are there?

Sophia wants to buy a new phone that costs $800. she saves $25 each week from her allowance and also sells old books for $150. after saving for 12 weeks, she receives a gift of $200 from her parents. how much more money does sophia need to buy the phone?
A bookstore sells novels for $12 each, textbooks for $25 each, and magazines for $5 each. if sarah buys 7 novels, 3 textbooks, and 10 magazines, how much does she spend in total?

Samantha builds a rectangular prism aquarium that measures 10 cm by 8 cm by 5 cm. the density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter. she fills the aquarium with water and sells it for $0.02 per gram. if she sells all the water in the aquarium, what is her total revenue?
A gardener plants 120 rose bushes and twice as many tulip bulbs. if she sells one-third of the rose bushes and half of the tulip bulbs, how many plants does she have left?

A basketball tournament has 5 rounds. there are 16 games in the first round, 8 in the second round, 4 in the third round, 2 in the semifinals, and 1 final game. if each game requires new basketballs, and on average each game uses 3 balls, how many basketballs in total are used at the end of the tournament?

Jason has a collection of 120 toy cars. 25% are red, 35% are blue, and the rest are green. he sells the red ones for $2 each, the blue ones for $3 each, and the green ones for $4 each. how much money does he make from selling all his toy cars?

A jacket was originally priced at $800. after two weeks, the price was reduced by 8%. since it still didn't sell, the selling price was further reduced by 6% a month later. what is the total reduction from the original price?
A cyclist rides at 12 miles per hour and then walks at 4 miles per hour. if he cycles for 3 miles and then walks for 2 miles, how many minutes will it take him to travel the full distance?

Emily takes a 12 hour bus ride to visit her grandparents. she spends 3 hours listening to music, 2 hours eating snacks, and 4 hours watching tv shows on her tablet. how many hours does she have left to sleep?

Five friends collectively read 150 books over the summer. the first friend read 40 books. the second friend read 10 fewer books than the first friend. the remaining three friends each read the same number of books. how many books did each of the last three friends read?

A baker bakes 60 cupcakes. 25% of the cupcakes are chocolate flavored. the baker decides to package half of the chocolate cupcakes in a box. if each cupcake has 3 sprinkles on top, how many sprinkles are there on the cupcakes in the box?

A library has 6 shelves of books. the first five shelves each contain 120 books, but the sixth shelf contains 15 fewer books than each of the other shelves. how many books are there in total on all six shelves?

Liam earns $0.75 for every tree he plants in his neighborhood. he planted 15 oak trees and twice as many pine trees. he also planted 25 maple trees and half that amount of birch trees. how much money did liam earn?

A baker makes chocolate and vanilla cupcakes. each chocolate cupcake requires 4 minutes to bake, and each vanilla cupcake requires 2 minutes. she bakes three times as many vanilla cupcakes as chocolate ones and spends a total of 48 minutes baking. how many minutes does she spend baking all the cupcakes?

A school has 150 students divided into four clubs: drama, science, art, and sports. there are 20 drama club members and three times as many science club members as drama. art club members make up 30% of the total number of students. how many students are in the sports club?

A baker bakes 1500 cookies in a day. he sells half of them at a 30% discount on the regular price of $2.00 each. for the other half, he charges full price. how much money will the baker make in total?
A bakery sells cupcakes for $2.50 each and cookies for $1.75 each. if a customer buys 8 cupcakes and 12 cookies, how much will the total cost be?
Liam and emma are organizing a charity bake sale. they baked 1,500 cookies in total. liam packaged 250 cookies while emma packaged 400 cookies. how many cookies are left to be packaged?

Liam wants to save up for a new bike that costs $600. he has already saved $150 and plans to save $30 every week from his allowance. if he also receives a one-time bonus of $90 from his parents, how many weeks will it take liam to have enough money to buy the bike?
Liam earns $15 an hour working at a bookstore. in the first week, he worked 10 hours; in the second week, he worked 5 hours more than the first week. how many hours did liam work over the two weeks?

Liam is landscaping his backyard, which measures 150 feet by 60 feet. he plans to install a patio that is 20 feet by 15 feet and plant flower beds around the patio totaling 300 square feet. how many square feet of grass will liam need to cover after installing the patio and flower beds?

Three days ago, aunt lisa planted 40 tulips in her garden. the next day, she planted 15 more tulips than the previous day. today, she planted three times the number of tulips than three days ago. how many tulips did aunt lisa plant in total?

Liam is preparing gift bags for a party. he needs to make 6 gift bags and 8 centerpieces. each gift bag requires 4 red balloons, and each centerpiece requires 10 red balloons. how many red balloons does liam need in total to complete all the gift bags and centerpieces?

A basketball game ended with the new york knicks scoring 84 points and the boston celtics scoring 76 points. if a two-point basket is worth 2 points and a three-point basket is worth 3 points, how many two-point baskets did the new york knicks make if they scored 12 three-point baskets during the game?

Liam owns 50 chickens. each chicken lays 3 eggs per day. liam plans to collect enough eggs to fill cartons that hold 12 eggs each. if he wants to fill 30 cartons, how many days will it take for liam to collect enough eggs?
A baker has 150 cupcakes and three times as many cookies. if she sells one-fourth of the cupcakes and one-third of the cookies, how many baked goods does she have left?
Samantha rents a storage unit for $150 per month. she also pays $20 weekly for supplies and $30 monthly for insurance. how much does she spend on the storage unit in one year?
